params.body:
Follow-up on #876: the rights dry run.

## The view right, read once

`GarageRights::menusOfRole()` had its own query on `role_access`. It now takes a role's menus from a new `AccessRights::forRole()`, which is the loop `AccessRights::forUser()` always ran (a row grants only when its menu exists and `view == 1`), pulled out so both use it. `forUser()` behaves exactly as before. The model and what a user of the role actually gets can no longer disagree.

A test pins it: every garage role carries a `user` row with every flag off, as on production, and that key appears in no set, in no garage's menus today and in no garage's gains. The same test checks `menusOfRole()` against `AccessRights::forRole()` for roles 3, 4 and 5.

Note for reading the next run: the query on main already filtered on `view = 1`, and a single `user` row with view 0 per role would not have put `user` in the base set with it. If the rerun still lists `user` under base, then roles 3 and 4 have `view = 1` on another menu row that carries the key `user`, and AccessRights grants those users the `/users` routes today. That would be worth a look on the menus table (`select id, parent_id, active, visible from menus where security = 'user'`).

## Four keys placed by name

`GarageRights::DECIDED` and `GarageRights::IGNORED`, each with its reason in the code:

- `export` goes with module_1: offering an own car for bidding (`/exports`, bids, agreement, borderel) sells from own stock; module_2 garages are the buyers that get the bidding mails. Applied when one of the three garage roles grants it.
- `merchant` goes with module_1: `MerchantController` works on the own `dealer_id`, the garage's own list of trader contacts, and it goes with export.
- `dealer` is administrator-only since #877 (`DealerController::authorizeGarageAdministration`): no module grants it, and it is printed as "admin only, ignored for garages".
- `verhicle` has no route: printed as "dead, no screen". A test fails if a route with that name ever appears.

Ignored keys are left out of both today and target, so they are never lost or gained. `undecided()` keeps working for any other key only role 5 grants: the test keeps a role-5-only key of its own and it still lands there.

## Output

- The model section lists the two decisions and the two ignored keys.
- "Menus lost" only counts screens (the ignored keys are out).
- Two lines at the top: from which date sign-ins are known, and from which date page views are known. Before that date, no sign-in is not evidence of none.

The classes and the CSV columns are unchanged.

## Checks

- `tests/Feature/RightsDryRunTest.php`: 14 tests, including the read-only guard tests, unchanged.
- Full suite locally: 2523 tests, OK.
- PHPStan: no errors. Pint: passes on the changed files.

No business rule describes the dry run, so `docs/bedrijfsregels/` is unchanged.

Rerun on production: `php artisan stocklist:rights-dry-run --csv=/tmp/rights-dry-run.csv`
params.title: The rights dry run reads the view right the way AccessRights does
